notes.title: Sounds of Her Love 2 - Out Now!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45384573/536e5afbcba6ed086fc710e2f3cabddb1cdfbb06.png"][/img][i]Special thanks to Kimiyoto for the release artwork![/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Sounds of Her Love 2 has been released![/b]

Thank you all so much for the support since our [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/603880/view/3681178469588234741"]first announcement[/url] of this sequel. It's been a pleasure reading comments and messages of support along the way, and I hope that we have been able to live up to your expectations. Ceri's story is as everyone's as much as it is ours, and to all those who have been positively impacted by it, I want to wish a warm thanks. 

SOHL 2 would not have been possible without the hard work of everyone who has contributed to the game's development along the way. Please check out the game's 'About' section when you get a chance! 

Of course, we will continue to support the game into the future and address any bugs or amendments (or additional content?) that need to be made. Though this is the end of one story, I hope you'll continue to support us as we work on current and future projects. 

Thank you,
ds-sans  [/p]
